nodes.en: To complete our example, convolutional layer C3 has 16 output feature maps, each of which is a 10 × 10 image. This layer has 6 × 16 = 96 filter banks, and each filter bank has 5 × 5 = 25 weights. The output of C3 is passed into the subsampling layer S4, which generates 16 5 × 5 output feature maps. Finally, the last convolutional layer C5 uses 16 × 120 = 1920 5 × 5 filter banks to generate 120 one-pixel output features from its 16 input feature maps.
nodes.zh: 完成我们的示例：卷积层 C3 有 16 个输出特征图，每个都是一幅 10×10 的图像。该层共有 6×16 = 96 个滤波器组，每个滤波器组有 5×5 = 25 个权重。C3 的输出被送入池化层 S4，后者生成 16 个 5×5 的输出特征图。最后，最后一个卷积层 C5 使用 16×120 = 1920 个 5×5 的滤波器组，从其 16 个输入特征图中生成 120 个单像素输出特征。

nodes.en: These feature maps are passed through fully connected layer F6, which has 84 output units, in which each output is fully connected to all inputs. The output is computed as a product of a weight matrix W with an input vector X, and then a bias is added and the output is passed through sigmoid. For the F6 example, W is a 120×84 matrix. In summary, the output is an 84-element vector Y6 = sigmoid (W * X + b). The reader should recognize that this is equivalent to 84 perceptrons, and each perceptron takes all 120 one-pixel x values generated by the C5 layer as its input. We leave the detailed implementation of a fully connected layer as an exercise.
nodes.zh: 这些特征图经过全连接层 F6，该层有 84 个输出单元，每个输出都与所有输入全连接。输出计算为权重矩阵 W 与输入向量 X 的乘积，然后加上偏置并经 sigmoid 函数。就 F6 而言，W 是一个 120×84 的矩阵。总之，输出是一个 84 维向量 Y6 = sigmoid(W * X + b)。读者应当认识到，这等价于 84 个感知机，每个感知机将 C5 层生成的所有 120 个单像素 x 值作为输入。全连接层的详细实现留作练习。

nodes.en: The final stage is an output layer that uses Gaussian filters to generate a vector of ten elements, which correspond to the probability that the input image contains one of the ten digits.
nodes.zh: 最后一级是一个输出层，它使用高斯滤波器生成一个十维向量，对应输入图像中包含十个数字之一的概率。

nodes.en: Convolutional neural network backpropagation
nodes.zh: 卷积神经网络的反向传播

nodes.en: Training of CNNs is based on the stochastic gradient descent method and the backpropagation procedure that were discussed in 【1】Section 16.1【/1】 (【2】Rumelhart et al., 1986【/2】). The training dataset is labeled with the “correct answer.” In the handwriting recognition example the labels give the correct letter in the image. The label information can be used to generate the “correct” output of the last stage: the correct probability values of the ten-element vector, where the probability of the correct digit is 1.0 and those for all other digits are 0.0.
nodes.zh: CNN 的训练基于随机梯度下降法和【1】16.1 节【/1】（【2】Rumelhart et al., 1986【/2】）中讨论的反向传播过程。训练数据集带有“正确答案”的标签。在手写体识别示例中，标签给出图像中正确的字母。标签信息可用于生成最后一级的“正确”输出：十维向量的正确概率值，其中正确数字的概率为 1.0，其余所有数字的概率为 0.0。

nodes.en: For each training image, the final stage of the network calculates the loss (error) function as the difference between the generated output probability vector element values and the “correct” output vector element values. Given a sequence of training images, we can numerically calculate the gradient of the loss function with respect to the elements of the output vector. Intuitively, it gives the rate at which the loss function value changes when the values of the output vector elements change.
nodes.zh: 对于每幅训练图像，网络的最后一级将损失（误差）函数计算为生成输出概率向量元素值与“正确”输出向量元素值之差。给定一系列训练图像，我们可以从数值上计算损失函数相对于输出向量各元素的梯度。直观地说，它表示当输出向量元素的值发生变化时，损失函数值变化的速率。

nodes.en: The backpropagation process starts by calculating the gradient of loss function 【M1】【M2】 for the last layer. It then propagates the gradient from the last layer toward the first layer through all layers of the network. Each layer receives as its input 【M3】【M4】 gradient with respect to its output feature maps (which is just the 【M5】【M6】 of the later layer) and computes its own 【M7】【M8】 gradient with respect to its input feature maps, as shown in 【9】Fig. 16.8B【/9】. This process repeats until it finishes adjusting the input layer of the network.
nodes.zh: 反向传播过程首先计算最后一层损失函数的梯度【M1】【M2】。然后它通过网络的所有层将梯度从最后一层向前一层传播。每一层以【M3】【M4】（即后一层的【M5】【M6】）作为关于其输出特征图的梯度输入，并计算其自身的【M7】【M8】（关于其输入特征图），如【9】图 16.8B【/9】所示。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 16.8【/1】 Backpropagation of (【2】A【/2】) 【M3】【M4】 and (【5】B【/5】) 【M6】【M7】 for a layer in CNN.

If a layer has learned parameters (“weights”) 【1】w【/1】, then the layer also computes its 【M2】【M3】 gradient of loss with respect to its weights, as shown in 【4】Fig. 16.8A【/4】. For example, the fully connected layer is given as 【5】y【/5】 = 【6】w · x【/6】. The backpropagation of the gradient 【M7】【M8】 is given by the following equation:
nodes.zh: 如果一层具有学习到的参数（“权重”）【1】w【/1】，那么该层还会计算其关于权重的损失梯度【M2】【M3】，如【4】图 16.8A【/4】所示。例如，全连接层表示为【5】y【/5】 = 【6】w · x【/6】。梯度【M7】【M8】的反向传播由下式给出：

nodes.en: This equation can be derived on an element-by-element basis, as we did for the two-layer perceptron example. Recall that each fully connected layer output pixel is calculated by a perceptron that takes the pixels in the input feature map as input. As we showed for training MLP in 【1】Section 16.1【/1】, 【M2】【M3】 for one of the inputs 【4】x【/4】 is the sum of products between 【M5】【M6】 for each output y element to which the input element contributes and the 【7】w【/7】 value via which the 【8】x【/8】 value contributes to the 【9】y【/9】 value. Because each row of the 【10】w【/10】 matrix relates all the 【11】x【/11】 elements (columns) to a 【12】y【/12】 element (one of the rows) for the fully connected layer, each column of 【13】w【/13】 (i.e., row of 【14】w【/14】【15】【16】T【/16】【/15】) relates all 【17】y【/17】 (【M18】【M19】 elements back to an 【20】x【/20】 (i.e., 【M21】【M22】) element, since transposition switches the roles of rows and columns. Thus the matrix-vector multiplication 【M23】【M24】 results in a vector that has the 【M25】【M26】 values for all input 【27】x【/27】 elements.
nodes.zh: 该方程可以在逐元素的基础上推导，正如我们对两层感知机示例所做的那样。回想一下，每个全连接层的输出像素是由一个感知机计算得到的，该感知机以输入特征图中的像素作为输入。正如我们在【1】16.1 节【/1】中对 MLP 训练所展示的，【M2】【M3】是某个输入【4】x【/4】的以下两项的乘积之和：该输入元素所贡献到的每个输出 y 元素的【M5】【M6】，以及该【7】w【/7】值（【8】x【/8】值借以贡献到【9】y【/9】值）。因为【10】w【/10】矩阵的每一行将全连接层的所有【11】x【/11】元素（列）关联到一个【12】y【/12】元素（行之一），而【13】w【/13】的每一列（即【14】w【/14】的【15】【16】T【/16】【/15】行）将所有【17】y【/17】（【M18】【M19】元素关联回一个【20】x【/20】（即【M21】【M22】）元素，因为转置交换了行和列的角色。因此矩阵-向量乘法【M23】【M24】得到一个向量，其【M25】【M26】值对应所有输入【27】x【/27】元素。

nodes.en: Similarly, since each 【1】w【/1】 element is multiplied by one 【2】x【/2】 element to generate a 【3】y【/3】 element, the 【M4】【M5】 of each w element can be calculated as the product of an element of 【M6】【M7】 with an 【8】x【/8】 element. Thus the matrix multiplication between 【M9】【M10】 (a single-column matrix) and 【M11】【M12】 (a single-row matrix) results in a matrix of 【M13】【M14】 values for all 【15】w【/15】 elements of the fully connected layer. This can also be seen as an outer product between the 【M16】【M17】 and 【M18】【M19】 vectors.
nodes.zh: 类似地，由于每个【1】w【/1】元素与一个【2】x【/2】元素相乘生成一个【3】y【/3】元素，因此每个 w 元素的【M4】【M5】可以计算为【M6】【M7】中的一个元素与一个【8】x【/8】元素的乘积。因此，【M9】【M10】（单列矩阵）与【M11】【M12】（单行矩阵）之间的矩阵乘法，得到了由【M13】【M14】值组成的矩阵，对应全连接层的所有【15】w【/15】元素。这也可以看作【M16】【M17】与【M18】【M19】向量之间的外积。

nodes.en: Let’s turn our attention to the backpropagation for a convolutional layer. We will start from the calculation of 【M1】【M2】 from 【M3】【M4】, which will ultimately be used to calculate the gradients for the previous layer. The gradient 【M5】【M6】 with respect to the channel 【7】c【/7】 of input 【8】x【/8】 is given as the sum of the “backward convolution” with the corresponding 【9】W【/9】(【10】m【/10】, 【11】c【/11】) over all the 【12】m【/12】 layer outputs:
nodes.zh: 现在让我们将注意力转向卷积层的反向传播。我们将从计算【M1】【M2】开始，它来自【M3】【M4】，该值最终将用于计算前一层的梯度。梯度【M5】【M6】关于通道【7】c【/7】、输入【8】x【/8】，表示为与相应【9】W【/9】（【10】m【/10】, 【11】c【/11】）的“反向卷积”之和，该和针对所有【12】m【/12】层输出：

nodes.en: The backward convolution through the 【M1】【M2】 and 【M3】【M4】 indexing allows the gradients of all output 【5】y【/5】 elements that received contributions from an 【6】x【/6】 element in the forward convolution to contribute to the gradient of that 【7】x【/7】 element through the same weights. This is because in the forward inference of the convolutional layer, any change in the value of the 【8】x【/8】 element is multiplied by these 【9】w【/9】 elements and contributes to the change in the loss function value through these 【10】y【/10】 elements. 【11】Fig. 16.9【/11】 shows the indexing pattern using a small example with 3 × 3 filter banks. The nine shaded 【12】y【/12】 elements in the output feature map are the 【13】y【/13】 elements that receive contributions from 【14】x【/14】【15】【16】h,w【/16】【/15】 in forward interference. For example, input element 【17】x【/17】【18】【19】h,w【/19】【/18】 contributes to 【20】y【/20】【21】【22】h【/22】−2,【23】w【/23】−2【/21】 through multiplication with 【24】w【/24】【25】2,2【/25】 and to 【26】y【/26】【27】【28】h,w【/28】【/27】 through multiplication with 【29】w【/29】【30】0,0【/30】. Therefore during backpropagation, 【M31】【M32】 should receive contribution from the 【M33】【M34】 values of these nine elements, and the computation is equivalent to a convolution with a transposed filter bank 【35】w【/35】【36】【37】T【/37】【/36】.
nodes.zh: 通过【M1】【M2】与【M3】【M4】索引进行的反向卷积，使得所有输出【5】y【/5】元素（它们在前向卷积中受到了某个【6】x【/6】元素的贡献）的梯度，能够通过相同的权重贡献到该【7】x【/7】元素的梯度。这是因为，在卷积层的前向推理中，【8】x【/8】元素值的任何变化都会乘以这些【9】w【/9】元素，并通过这些【10】y【/10】元素贡献到损失函数值的变化。【11】图 16.9【/11】用一个 3×3 滤波器组的小例子展示了索引模式。输出特征图中的九个阴影【12】y【/12】元素便是那些【13】y【/13】元素，它们在前向卷积中受到【14】x【/14】【15】【16】h,w【/16】【/15】的贡献。例如，输入元素【17】x【/17】【18】【19】h,w【/19】【/18】贡献到【20】y【/20】【21】【22】h【/22】−2,【23】w【/23】−2【/21】，通过乘以【24】w【/24】【25】2,2【/25】，并贡献到【26】y【/26】【27】【28】h,w【/28】【/27】，通过乘以【29】w【/29】【30】0,0【/30】。因此在反向传播期间，【M31】【M32】应当从这些九个元素【M33】【M34】的值中获得贡献，并且该计算等价于与转置滤波器组【35】w【/35】【36】【37】T【/37】【/36】的卷积。

nodes.en: 【1】【2】Figure 16.9【/2】【/1】 Convolutional layer. Backpropagation of (【3】A【/3】) ∂【4】E【/4】/∂【5】w【/5】 and (【6】B【/6】) ∂【7】E【/7】/∂【8】x【/8】.

【1】Fig. 16.10【/1】 shows the C code for calculating each element of 【M2】【M3】 for each input feature map. Note that the code assumes that 【M4】【M5】 has been calculated for all the output feature maps of the layer and passed in with a pointer argument dE_dY. This is a reasonable assumption, since 【M6】【M7】 for the current layer is the 【M8】【M9】 for its immediate next layer, whose gradients should have been calculated in the backpropagation before reaching the current layer. It also assumes that the space of 【M10】【M11】 has been allocated in the device memory whose handle is passed in as a pointer argument dE_dX. The function generates all the elements of 【M12】【M13】.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 16.10【/1】 展示了用于计算每个输入特征图的【M2】【M3】中每个元素的 C 代码。请注意，该代码假设【M4】【M5】已经为该层的所有输出特征图计算完毕，并通过指针参数 dE_dY 传入。这是一个合理的假设，因为当前层的【M6】【M7】就是其紧邻下一层的【M8】【M9】，而下一层的梯度在到达当前层之前的反向传播中应当已经计算好。它还假设【M10】【M11】的空间已经在设备内存中分配，其句柄作为指针参数 dE_dX 传入。该函数生成【M12】【M13】的所有元素。

nodes.en: 【1】【2】Figure 16.10【/2】【/1】 【M3】【M4】 calculation of the backward path of a convolutional layer.

The sequential code for calculating 【M1】【M2】 for a convolutional layer computation is similar to that of 【M3】【M4】 and is shown in 【5】Fig. 16.11【/5】. Since each 【6】W【/6】(【7】m【/7】, 【8】c【/8】) affects all elements of output 【9】Y【/9】(【10】m【/10】), we should accumulate gradients for each 【11】W【/11】(【12】m【/12】, 【13】c【/13】) over all pixels in the corresponding output feature map:
nodes.zh: 用于计算卷积层【M1】【M2】的顺序代码与计算【M3】【M4】的类似，如【5】图 16.11【/5】所示。由于每个【6】W【/6】（【7】m【/7】, 【8】c【/8】）影响输出【9】Y【/9】（【10】m【/10】）的所有元素，我们应当针对每个【11】W【/11】（【12】m【/12】, 【13】c【/13】）在相应输出特征图的所有像素上累加梯度：

nodes.en: 【1】【2】Figure 16.11【/2】【/1】 【M3】【M4】 calculation of the backward path of a convolutional layer.

Note that while the calculation of 【M1】【M2】 is important for propagating the gradient to the previous layer, the calculation of the 【M3】【M4】 is key to the adjustments to the weight values of the current layer.
nodes.zh: 请注意，虽然【M1】【M2】的计算对于将梯度传播到前一层很重要，但【M3】【M4】的计算对于调整当前层权重值才是关键。

nodes.en: After the 【M1】【M2】 values at all filter bank element positions have been computed, weights are updated to minimize the expected error using the formula presented in 【3】Section 16.1【/3】: 【4】w ← w − ε*【/4】 【M5】【M6】, where ε is the learning rate constant. The initial value of ε is set empirically and reduced through the epochs according to the rule defined by user. The value of ε is reduced through the epochs to ensure that the weights converge to a minimal error. Recall that the negative sign of the adjustment term causes the change to be opposite to the direction of the gradient so that the change will likely reduce the error. Recall also that the weight values of the layers determine how the input is transformed through the network. The adjustment of these weight values of all the layers adapts the behavior of the network. That is, the network “learns” from a sequence of labeled training data and adapts its behavior by adjusting all weight values at all its layers for inputs whose inference results were incorrect and triggered backpropagation.
nodes.zh: 在所有滤波器组元素位置上的【M1】【M2】值都计算完成后，将更新权重以最小化期望误差，所使用的公式如【3】16.1 节【/3】所示：【4】w ← w − ε*【/4】 【M5】【M6】，其中 ε 为学习率常数。ε 的初始值凭经验设定，并在各轮次中按照用户定义的规则递减。ε 的值在各轮次中递减，以确保权重收敛到最小误差。回想一下，调整项的负号使得变化方向与梯度方向相反，从而变化可能会减小误差。还要回想，各层的权重值决定了输入在网络中如何被变换。调整所有层的这些权重值会使网络的行为自适应。也就是说，网络从一系列带标签的训练数据中“学习”，并通过针对那些推理结果不正确并触发了反向传播的输入，调整其所有层的所有权重值，从而使自身行为自适应。

nodes.en: As we discussed in 【1】Section 16.1【/1】, backpropagation is typically triggered after a forward pass has been performed on a minibatch of 【2】N【/2】 images from the training dataset, and the gradients have been computed for this minibatch. The learned weights are updated with the gradients that are calculated for the minibatch, and the process is repeated with another minibatch.【3】【4】2【/4】【/3】 This adds one additional dimension to all previously described arrays, indexed with 【5】n【/5】, the index of the sample in the minibatch. It also adds one additional loop over samples.
nodes.zh: 正如我们在【1】16.1 节【/1】中所讨论的，反向传播通常在对来自训练数据集的一个小批量【2】N【/2】图像执行完前向计算之后被触发，并且已经针对该小批量计算出了梯度。学习到的权重用为该小批量计算出的梯度进行更新，然后这一过程用另一个小批量重复进行。【3】【4】2【/4】【/3】 这为所有前面描述的数组增加了一个额外的维度，其索引为【5】n【/5】（小批量中样本的索引）。它还增加了一个额外的样本循环。

nodes.en: 【1】Fig. 16.12【/1】 shows the revised forward path implementation of a convolutional layer. It generates the output feature maps for all the samples of a minibatch.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 16.12【/1】 展示了卷积层修订后的前向路径实现。它为该小批量的所有样本生成输出特征图。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 16.12【/1】 Forward path of a convolutional layer with minibatch training.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 16.12【/1】 带小批量训练的卷积层前向路径。

nodes.en: 16.3 Convolutional layer: a CUDA inference kernel
nodes.zh: 16.3 卷积层：一个 CUDA 推理核函数

nodes.en: The computation pattern in training a convolutional neural network is like matrix multiplication: It is both compute intensive and highly parallel. We can process different samples in a minibatch, different output feature maps for the same sample, and different elements for each output feature map in parallel. In 【1】Fig. 16.12【/1】 the n-loop (line 04, over samples in a minibatch), the m-loop (line 05, over output feature maps), and the nested h-w-loops (lines 06–07, over pixels of each output feature map) are all parallel loops in that their iterations can be executed in parallel. These four loop levels together offer a massive level of parallelism.
nodes.zh: 训练卷积神经网络（CNN）的计算模式类似于矩阵乘法：它既计算密集又高度并行。我们可以并行地处理小批量中不同的样本、同一样本不同的输出特征图，以及每个输出特征图不同的元素。在【1】图 16.12【/1】中，n 循环（第 04 行，遍历小批量中的样本）、m 循环（第 05 行，遍历输出特征图）以及嵌套的 h-w 循环（第 06–07 行，遍历每个输出特征图的像素）都是并行循环，因为它们的迭代可以并行执行。这四个循环层级共同提供了大规模的并行度。
